violation_type.title: Children Handwashing After Contact with Harmful Substance (26 TAC §746.3417(7))
violation_type.short_title: Children Handwashing After Contact with Harmful Substance
violation_type.typical_finding: A child in care spit up on the carpet and then crawled through the spit up, including their hands coming into direct contact and the staff did not assist the child with appropriate hand washing practices after.

finding_variants.text: A child in care spit up on the carpet and then crawled through the spit up, including their hands coming into direct contact and the staff did not assist the child with appropriate hand washing practices after.

Children were observed touching the trashcan after throwing their lunch plates away. The children then laid down without washing their hands.     This was corrected at inspection when the caregiver had the children wash their hands.
A child was not made to wash their hands after contact with a harmful substance.    This was corrected at inspection when a caregiver assisted the child with washing their hands.
